channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Casado: Flávio Bolsonaro está isolado e escolha por Gaspar surpreende
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro arrived at the presidential campaign isolated, lacking significant support from his own party or radical right leaders, according to columnist Letícia Casado. The choice of Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as running mate surprised the political class, as Gaspar is not a nationally recognized figure nor aligned with the main currents of bolsonarism. The decision was seen as either a waste of political capital or a sign of disorganization within the ticket.

item.title: Crises diplomáticas do Brasil com EUA e Argentina se agravam
item.description: Diplomatic relations between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) government and the United States under Donald Trump, as well as with Javier Milei's Argentina, deteriorated severely within 24 hours. This escalation comes at a critical juncture, just two months before Brazil's 2026 elections, raising concerns about potential impacts on trade alliances and geopolitical positioning.

item.title: Resultados das Eleições 2026 poderão ser acompanhados em tempo real
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will make available the 'Resultados' portal and mobile app for real-time tracking of the 2026 General Elections vote tally, starting at 5:00 p.m. Brasília time after polls close. Data will be updated as ballot booth reports are received and processed, enabling users to consult results by state, municipality, and office — including presidential votes cast in Brazil and abroad — for both the first round (October 4) and potential second round (October 25).

item.title: Alagoas: MDB lança Renan Filho ao governo e Calheiros ao Senado
item.description: The MDB launched Renan Filho as its candidate for governor of Alagoas and Renan Calheiros for Senate re-election, with the vice-governor position still undecided. The party is negotiating with the PT to include a petista on the ticket, while the opposition, led by JHC of the PSDB, is seeking a coalition with the União Progressista Federation following Gaspar's withdrawal.

item.title: PGR denuncia Oswaldo Eustáquio ao STF por associação criminosa em atos golpistas
item.description: The Attorney General’s Office filed a complaint before the Supreme Federal Court against blogger Oswaldo Eustáquio, a fugitive residing in Spain, for criminal association in anti-democratic acts. He is accused of participating in protests, encampments, and military-front mobilizations aimed at undermining the legitimacy of the electoral system and the Democratic State of Law, including social media posts and alleged presence at the Alvorada Palace in 2022. Spain denied his extradition in December 2025, citing lack of dual criminality and political motivation in the Brazilian investigation.

item.title: Saiba como consultar seu local de votação nas eleições de outubro
item.description: Voters across Brazil can now check their polling locations for the 2026 elections via the TSE website using CPF, mother’s name, and date of birth, or through the e-Título app. The first round is scheduled for October 4, with a potential runoff on October 25. The TRE of Rio de Janeiro has changed 66 electoral zones, affecting 188,000 voters in 20 municipalities, citing security concerns due to organized crime dominance in certain areas.

item.title: Racha entre PP e União Brasil ameaça palanque de Raquel Lyra em Pernambuco
item.description: The convention of the União Progressista Federation in Pernambuco ended without consensus on the coalition for Governor Raquel Lyra's (PSD) re-election bid, due to a split between PP and União Brasil in forming the ticket. Official support for the governor was postponed until the deadline, threatening the unity of her electoral slate. The decision remains pending, reflecting internal divisions within the allied base.

item.title: Brasil confirma que su embajador no regresará a Argentina hasta que cesen “los reiterados insultos y agresiones” de Milei
item.description: Brazil has decided to keep its ambassador in Argentina withdrawn and bilateral relations at the charge d'affaires level until Argentine President Javier Milei ceases his repeated insults and attacks against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira stated the move is a direct response to Milei’s remarks, in which he called Lula a 'convict', 'corrupt', and 'socialist trash'. The Argentine government has not apologized, attributing the tensions to ideological differences.

item.title: A dois meses da eleição, Brasil enfrenta crises diplomáticas inéditas com EUA e Argentina
item.description: Two months ahead of the 2026 presidential elections, Brazil is facing an unprecedented diplomatic crisis with both the United States and Argentina, following the downgrade of relations with Buenos Aires and the revocation of the Brazilian ambassador’s visa in Washington by the Trump administration. The tensions stem from repeated attacks by Argentine President Javier Milei against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and the U.S.’s unilateral announcement of Daniel Perez as ambassador to Brasília without prior Brazilian agrément. Experts describe the situation as unprecedented due to the gravity and simultaneity of the events.

item.title: “Flávio perdeu a oportunidade de colocar uma mulher como vice”, diz Malafaia
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia criticized the choice of Alfredo Gaspar as running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro, saying the senator missed the opportunity to nominate a woman for the position. He noted that none of the main presidential candidates have a woman as vice president and argued this choice represents a lost chance to advance female representation in politics.

item.title: Debates das eleições 2026: veja calendário, datas e regras dos principais debates presidenciais
item.description: The schedule for the 2026 presidential debates is taking shape, with the first debate set for August 23, hosted by Band in partnership with TV Cultura, TV Gazeta, and Jovem Pan. Eleven candidates have so far declared their intention to run, but the final list will only be confirmed after the August 15 candidacy registration deadline. Lula (PT) said he will not attend debates if it's 'just to hear nonsense', while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will only participate if Lula is present.

item.title: Em entrevista a programa argentino, Mauro Vieira diz que questão ideológica é secundária
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira stated in an interview with Argentine TV that Brazil's reduction of diplomatic relations with Argentina was a response to President Javier Milei's attacks on Lula, but that ideological considerations are secondary. He emphasized that Lula maintains good international relations regardless of the ruling party's color and that respect and education are fundamental to bilateral ties.

item.title: Nova lei cria rota turística entre Porto Alegre e Serra Gaúcha
item.description: Law 15.482/26 establishes the Vale da Felicidade Tourism Route, covering 20 municipalities between the Porto Alegre metropolitan region and the Serra Gaúcha, aiming to promote cultural, rural, historical, and adventure tourism. Originating from Bill 1028/22 by Deputy Osmar Terra (PL-RS), the law was signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and published in the Official Gazette on March 4. The route will receive support from official programs for the structuring, management, and promotion of local tourist attractions.

item.title: Vice de Flávio terá missão de explorar caso Lulinha no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has nominated federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL) as his running mate and tasked him with leading the campaign in the Northeast, focusing on investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) over alleged INSS fraud. The strategy aims to counter allegations linking Flávio to former banker Daniel Vorcaro by highlighting Gaspar’s role in the INSS CPMI as a counter-narrative. Allies hope to strengthen the association between Lula’s son and corruption schemes under STF investigation.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede autorização para visita de Flávio no dia dos pais
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro requested permission for him to receive visits from his sons Flávio, Carlos, and Renan on Father's Day (August 9, 2026), citing humanitarian and family reasons. The request follows a ban on visits imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who ruled that Bolsonaro violated house arrest measures by having a letter read by Flávio on social media, constituting indirect use of social media by third parties. The defense argues Bolsonaro did not authorize the letter's disclosure and that the senator acted independently.

item.title: Após três eleições com mulheres nas principais chapas, corrida presidencial de 2026 começa sem nenhuma vice feminina
item.description: The confirmation of Alfredo Gaspar as running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro marks the first time since 2014 that none of the leading presidential candidates in the 2026 election will have a woman as vice president, ending a streak of three consecutive elections with female representation on major tickets. The absence of women in vice-presidential slots reflects a setback in gender diversity within Brazil’s presidential races.

item.title: Vieira nega campanha de Lula contra Milei e chama fala de "descabida"
item.description: Brazil's Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira denied Argentine President Javier Milei's accusation that the Lula government financed Sergio Massa's 2023 election campaign with $1 billion, calling the claim 'absurd' and 'baseless'. Vieira stated that such an amount is incompatible with any electoral spending in Brazil and reaffirmed that Brazil does not interfere in foreign electoral processes.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede a Moraes autorização para receber visita dos filhos no Dia dos Pais
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense requested exceptional authorization from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to allow visits from his sons Carlos, Jair Renan, and Flávio on Father's Day (June 9), following a 30- to 90-day suspension of visits due to judicial violations. The request emphasizes humanitarian and familial grounds, asserting that the visits will not interfere with the fulfillment of his sentence or precautionary measures.

item.title: Marcola ajudou lobista amiga de Lulinha a chegar à Saúde
item.description: Marcola, former Chief of Staff to Lula, informally received financial assistance from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who paid his bills in exchange for access to authorities, including the Ministry of Health. The connection was facilitated by Lulinha and Renata, close friends of the lobbyist. Despite denying any health contracts with the 'INSS Careca', Marcola was removed from government in July after Lula learned of the situation, and Oswaldo Malatesta replaced him.

item.title: Justiça absolve fazendeiro acusado de ameaçar dar um tiro em Lula
item.description: The Federal Court of Pará acquitted farmer Arilson Strapasson, who was arrested in August 2023 on suspicion of threatening to kill President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The ruling was issued on May 8, 2026, following a review of the evidence presented in the case.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que vai compor com 'parasitas e vagabundos' do centrão
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, referred to members of the 'centrão' as 'parasites and vagabonds' during a g1 and GloboNews interview, but stated he would negotiate with them if elected. The remark sparked controversy due to its harsh tone, though it signals a willingness to form political alliances.

item.title: Escolha de vice de Flávio pega integrantes da campanha de surpresa e desagrada aliados
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket surprised and disappointed campaign insiders, who had expected a woman for the role and criticize the allegations of rape of a minor and TCU irregularities against Gaspar, now being exploited by opponents. Despite claims that he aligns with public security, allies view the pick as questionable and lacking electoral value.

item.title: Filha de Clezão, morto na Papuda, quer ver Bolsonaro na domiciliar
item.description: Luiza Cunha, daughter of Cleriston Pereira da Cunha, known as Clezão, requested authorization from Minister Alexandre de Moraes to make a humanitarian visit to former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest, to offer comfort following her father's death. Clezão died in November 2023 at the Papuda prison complex due to health complications linked to Covid-19, while being held preventively for his alleged involvement in the January 8, 2023 riots. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year sentence for attempted coup and was granted house arrest in March.

item.title: Escolha de Alfredo Gaspar para vice de Flávio mira fragilidades do governo Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign selected Alfredo Gaspar as running mate after failing to secure a female candidate from the Centrão bloc. Gaspar, a former public security secretary and INSS CPI rapporteur, was chosen to directly challenge Lula's government on public safety, pension fraud, and to strengthen the party's foothold in the Northeast—a traditional PT stronghold. The move leverages ongoing investigations involving Lula's associates and family, while symbolically including female leaders in the announcement to mitigate the all-male ticket's impact.

item.title: Tarcísio tenta se afastar de duas marcas do bolsonarismo
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) sought to distance himself from two core tenets of Bolsonarism by stating he would no longer wear a cap in support of Donald Trump and reaffirming his trust in electronic voting machines. The remarks were made in an interview with RedeTV! on Tuesday, February 4. The move signals an effort to reposition himself politically ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Roscoe sobre eleição em MG: "Passo mais importante da vida pública"
item.description: Flávio Roscoe (PL) stated that his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais is 'one of the most important steps' of his public life, following his nomination by Flávio Bolsonaro as the party's candidate. He emphasized that the candidacy is a collective call to unite the mineiro right around a project of development, security, and prosperity, above personal interests, and noted that the PL's decision to launch his candidacy came after Cleitinho (Republicanos) withdrew from the race.

item.title: Por que Nikolas Ferreira e outros bolsonaristas voltaram a explorar desinformação sobre a pandemia de Covid-19 às vésperas da eleição
item.description: Allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro, including Nikolas Ferreira and Eduardo Bolsonaro, revived pandemic-related misinformation about vaccines, masks, and health measures, using Anthony Fauci’s U.S. Senate testimony — where he invoked the Fifth Amendment over 100 times — as alleged evidence of wrongdoing. Experts clarify that invoking the Fifth Amendment is a legal right and does not constitute guilt or invalidate scientific consensus on Covid-19 interventions. The disinformation campaign is being deployed ahead of the 2026 elections to re-energize Bolsonaro’s base.

item.title: 'Eu não sou o Bukele', diz Renan Santos ao falar de segurança pública
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, stated he does not intend to replicate El Salvador President Nayib Bukele's public security measures in Brazil, despite admiring their effectiveness. He emphasized that Brazil's context is different and that his actions would respect constitutional limits, rejecting warrantless arrests, collective trials, and detentions based solely on anonymous tips. In an interview with g1 and GloboNews, he stressed his focus on combating organized crime within legal frameworks, taking into account specificities like the PCC.

item.title: Após ser cotada para vice, Daniella Marques apoia Gaspar
item.description: Former Caixa Econômica Federal president Daniella Marques expressed support for deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) after being considered as a potential vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket. In a social media post, Marques wished Gaspar success, signaling alignment with the party's choice for the 2026 vice-presidential nomination.

item.title: Vice de Flávio, Gaspar é investigado por repasse de R$ 6 mi em emendas
item.description: Federal Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), selected as the vice-presidential running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for the 2026 elections, is under investigation by the TCU for directing R$ 6 million in 'Pix amendments' to the municipality of São José da Laje (AL) between July and December 2024. Gaspar’s defense claims the transfers were lawful, based on a work plan and requested by former municipal manager Rodrigo Valença, and intended for a key regional hub. Despite the probe, Gaspar pledged loyalty to Flávio Bolsonaro and vowed to fight corruption, organized crime, and the economic crisis.

item.title: “Alfredo Gaspar estava no radar de Flávio como vice há tempos”, diz Valdemar
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, stated that Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) had been on Flávio Bolsonaro’s radar as a running mate for some time, since the senator decided to launch his presidential pre-candidacy. The choice came after centrist parties refused to support the campaign, making it a negotiated alternative. The information was published in a subscriber-exclusive article.

item.title: Presidentes do TSE e do Senado Federal defendem a confiança no processo eleitoral
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, defended confidence in Brazil's electoral system during the opening of the "O Caminho do Voto" exhibition at the Federal Senate, emphasizing that the electoral process involves preparation, execution, and oversight long before voters press the 'CONFIRMA' button. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre also attended the event, which highlighted the electronic ballot box as a product of joint action by republican institutions and ongoing technical and legislative improvement.

item.title: A medida de Flávio Bolsonaro para facilitar registro de candidatura
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) preemptively paid a 25,000 reais fine from 2022 over a social media post accusing Lula of supporting abortion, in order to obtain his electoral clearance and register as a candidate for the 2026 elections. He made the payment voluntarily before being formally notified, speeding up the closure of the case and avoiding the enforcement phase. The strategy succeeded, allowing him to meet the August 16 deadline for candidate registration.

item.title: Irmão de Bruno Gagliasso debocha de ator após reclamação contra McDonald’s
item.description: Bruno Gagliasso's brother, Thiago Gagliasso, a state deputy from PL-RJ, mocked him in an Instagram video after Bruno criticized a McDonald's in Petrópolis for closing 10 minutes early. Thiago joked that Bruno can eat a 'McPicanha' because he voted for Lula and sarcastically complained about his stance on the 6×1 work schedule, while announcing he will propose the 'PL Bruno Gagliasso' to keep all McDonald's open 24 hours a day.

item.title: Aliados de Lula dizem que escolha de vice de Flávio expõe isolamento e veem tentativa de explorar caso INSS
item.description: Lula's allies say Alfredo Gaspar's selection as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate exposes the senator's isolation after failing to secure center-party alliances. They view the move as an attempt to exploit the INSS scandal to damage the Petista government's image, though they believe it won't alter the already-established electoral landscape. The Petista campaign aims to link the scandal to the Bolsonaro government, emphasizing that the investigation was ordered by Lula and that victims were reimbursed.

item.title: Escolha de Gaspar como vice de Flávio reforça tema Lulinha na campanha, mas tem efeitos colaterais
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate strengthens the strategy of attacking Lula through the INSS illegal discount scandal involving Lulinha, but brings collateral effects, including exposure to unproven allegations of rape of a vulnerable person and contradicting prior promises to choose a woman for the ticket. Gaspar, nationally obscure and from a centrist party, is seen as a weak addition in terms of broad electorate appeal.

item.title: Eleições 2026: g1 e GloboNews entrevistam Renan Santos, candidato do Missão à Presidência
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate for 2026, was interviewed by g1 and GloboNews on governability, fiscal PEC, public safety, and state of defense. He stated that, if elected, he would seek alliances with the Centrão to advance his agenda and proposed 'splitting' the fiscal PEC to ease its approval. On security, he emphasized he does not intend to follow Nayib Bukele's model in El Salvador, advocating a distinct approach to combating crime.

item.title: Crusoé: Programas de Lula perdem tração
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll released on March 5 shows that several of Lula's government programs, designed to win voter support, are losing traction as the 2026 campaign officially begins. The deadline for parties to submit their slates to the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ended on March 5, leaving only 60 days until the election. The weakening impact of these programs comes at a crucial moment for Lula's re-election bid.

item.title: Ex-chefe de Gabinete de Lula deixa a campanha
item.description: Former Chief of Staff to President Lula, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), has withdrawn from the president’s re-election campaign after it was revealed he received funds from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha. The disclosure was reported by O Estado de S.Paulo and reiterated by O Antagonista. His departure comes amid growing scrutiny over potential conflicts of interest and the influence of private money in the campaign.

item.title: Ministro diz que ataques de Milei a Lula são tentativa de ‘destruir’ relação entre os dois países
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira stated that Argentine President Javier Milei's attacks on Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva are an attempt to 'destroy' Brazil-Argentina relations. He confirmed that Brazil's ambassador to Argentina will remain in Brazil until satisfactory explanations are provided for Milei's repeated offenses, and that Argentina's embassy will be led by a chargé d'affaires. Vieira emphasized that bilateral relations have been exemplary since 1985 and expressed regret that this special bond is now being undermined.

item.title: TRE forma maioria para manter Pablo Marçal inelegível
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) formed a majority to keep Pablo Marçal ineligible until 2032, blocking his candidacy for elected office during that period. Marçal, a Senate candidate from São Paulo, may still appeal to the TSE. Despite his ineligibility, he could run in 'sub judice' elections under electoral law.

item.title: Renan Santos chama parlamentares de 'parasitas' e diz que, se eleito, vai compor com Centrão e fatiar PEC fiscal
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, said he would call centrist parliamentarians 'parasites' and, if elected, negotiate with them to pass the Fiscal PEC, including the possibility of splitting the proposal to ease its passage in Congress. He stated Brazil faces a 'fiscal drama' and proposes decoupling funds for health and education, as well as de-indexing benefits like pensions and BPC from the minimum wage. The interview was part of a series with presidential candidates, with Lula drawn first but not attending.

item.title: Federação Psol-Rede aprova apoio a Lula nas eleições: “Derrotar o extremismo”
item.description: The Psol-Rede Sustainability federation unanimously approved, at its national convention, support for the presidential ticket of Lula (PT) and Geraldo Alckmin in the 2026 elections. The decision aims to defeat political extremism in Brazil and includes joining the government’s electoral coalition. The position was formalized on Wednesday, April 5.

item.title: Flávio Roscoe é anunciado como candidato ao Governo de MG pelo PL
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) announced businessman Flávio Roscoe as its candidate for Governor of Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections. The announcement was made in a video featuring Flávio Bolsonaro, PL senator from Rio de Janeiro and presidential candidate, signaling strong party backing for the ticket.

item.title: Lula diz que ligará para Trump e pedirá reunião na ONU
item.description: President Lula said he will call Donald Trump to urge the UN Security Council to resume meetings, criticizing its ineffectiveness in the face of the wars in Ukraine and Palestine. He had already made the same request to Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, speaking recently with Putin about the Ukraine conflict. Lula believes the war in Ukraine should have ended and views its continuation as a failure of the UN.

item.title: Saiba quem é Flávio Roscoe, candidato ao governo de Minas pelo PL
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, former president of Fiemg and textile industry businessman, was announced as the PL candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, following internal party negotiations and the withdrawal of Cleitinho Azevedo from the Republicans. At 51, with a history background and experience at Grupo Colortextil, he is backed by Flávio Bolsonaro and noted for his good relations with federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira.

item.title: Escolha de Gaspar para vice de Flávio não empolgou a Faria Lima
item.description: The selection of federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate failed to excite Faria Lima, which views the pick as a missed opportunity to broaden the ticket's electoral appeal, particularly by not choosing a woman from another party to reduce female voter resistance to Bolsonarismo. A rape of a vulnerable person allegation against Gaspar, with the PF requesting an STF investigation, raised fears of campaign contamination, despite his denial and claims of political persecution tied to his INSS CPI work. While Faria Lima acknowledges positives — his Northeastern roots, INSS CPI role, and tough-on-crime/anti-corruption rhetoric — it concludes the choice fell short of market expectations for electoral gain.

item.title: ‘Não é uma eleição confortável para Lula’, diz CEO do Ideia sobre nova pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows Lula leading with 43% in the first round and 48.5% in a potential runoff, compared to 35% and 43% for Flávio Bolsonaro. The race is described as crystallized due to strong polarization, with 66% of voters already decided and little room for alternative candidates. Despite the lead, Ideia CEO Cila Schulman states it is not a comfortable election for the incumbent, as the outcome will be tight and corruption has returned as a top voter concern.

item.title: Nikolas comemora escolha por Roscoe: "Flávio em MG e Flávio no Brasil"
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) celebrated the confirmation of Flávio Roscoe, former president of Fiemg, as the PL's candidate for governor of Minas Gerais in the 2026 elections. The decision followed the failure of negotiations to have Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) as the party's nominee, which left him without a party. Roscoe, who had resigned from Fiemg and joined the PL, said the party tried to make Cleitinho's candidacy viable, but after over 120 days of waiting, opted to launch its own ticket, positioning itself as Flávio Bolsonaro's slate in MG.

item.title: Atitude irresponsável, diz Lula após revogação de visto de embaixadora
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva condemned the revocation of Brazilian Ambassador Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti's U.S. visa by the Trump administration as irresponsible and irresponsible, and disrespectful to Brazil's 203-year diplomatic tradition. He stressed that the U.S. has not sent an ambassador to Brazil in over a year and warned against foreign interference in Brazil's upcoming October elections.
